subject.title: Model configuration accepts unvalidated model names, enabling silent misconfiguration

question: Should unknown configured model refs be warning-only in `config validate` and doctor, hard validation errors, or runtime/startup-only diagnostics when catalog authority is incomplete?
rationale: The code can enumerate the relevant refs, but the severity choice affects custom providers, forward-compatible model names, provider/plugin catalogs, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose the policy alone.

options.title: Warning-first validation
options.body: Add catalog-backed warnings in `config validate` and doctor for unknown configured refs, with wording that distinguishes trusted catalog absence from intentional custom or future models.

options.title: Strict validation
options.body: Reject unknown configured refs at config validation/write time, accepting a compatibility break unless an explicit escape contract is added.

options.title: Runtime-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep config validation permissive and rely on startup/runtime errors, fallback notices, and doctor hints rather than adding a broad analyzer now.

recommendation.title: Warning-first validation
recommendation.body: Add catalog-backed warnings in `config validate` and doctor for unknown configured refs, with wording that distinguishes trusted catalog absence from intentional custom or future models.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans model catalog architecture, OpenAI/provider identity, and config compatibility policy where this person has the strongest observed feature-history signal.
